# Changelog

All notable changes to the "Bash Debug" extension will be documented in this file.

## [0.1.0] - Unreleased

### Added
- Initial release with full bashdb DAP integration
- Source breakpoints with gutter click support
- Conditional breakpoints with expression validation
- Hit count breakpoints
- Function breakpoints
- Log points (print without stopping)
- Data breakpoints / watchpoints (break on variable change)
- Variable inspection panel with locals, globals, and environment scopes
- Array and associative array expandable tree visualization
- Variable modification from Variables panel
- Watch expressions panel
- Hover evaluation for variables
- Debug console with expression evaluation
- Debug console autocomplete (completions)
- Stack trace with frame navigation
- Exception breakpoints (ERR, SIGINT, SIGTERM)
- Loaded sources tracking
- Session restart without re-launching
- Prerequisite detection with actionable error messages
- Support for bash ≥ 4.0 (4.4+ recommended)
